此工作流程重点关注 MiniMax H3 的 Larry Turbo LoRA 加速路线。它针对的是需要紧凑、快速的图像到视频设置、涡轮采样器策略和易于测试的简单结构的用户。

主动链使用 MiniMax H3 修剪的 INT8 ConvRot 模型、Qwen3-VL MiniMax INT8 ConvRot 文本编码器、MiniMax H3 视频和音频 VAE 以及启用的 Larry Turbo LoRA。该图以 16:9 输出路径和短步采样设置为中心。

该软件包适用于需要现成的 MiniMax H3 图而不是手动重建加载器、编码器、VAE、采样器和视频导出连接的实用 ComfyUI 和 RunningHub 用户。该工作流程对于速度比较、硬件规划和可重复的提示测试特别有用。比较版本时保持相同的源图像和提示，这样您看到的差异来自工作流程路线，而不是来自更改创意变量。

主要特点：

- Larry Turbo LoRA 在可达生成路径上启用
- MiniMax H3 修剪了 INT8 ConvRot 模型路线以实现更轻的执行
- Qwen3-VL MiniMax INT8 ConvRot 文本编码
- 采用 beta 6 步计划的欧拉采样
- 用于视频创作的 16:9 宽屏分辨率选择器
- 干净的单输出 SaveVideo 路线
- 非常适合快速图像到视频的口语或角色动作测试

建议的工作流程：

使用一张清晰的起始图像并保持拍摄对象干净利落。因为这是一条快速路线，所以首先测试保守的提示：稳定的面部、受控的手部运动、轻微的相机移动以及简短的语音（如果使用音频）。如果运动变得太松散，请在更改模型路径之前降低提示复杂性。

为了更好地进行比较，首先进行一个小测试，检查身份稳定性和时间运动，然后仅在基本路线表现正确后才提高提示复杂性。使用语音角色提示时，保持面部可见，避免过多的快速切换，并将动作、表情和镜头指令清晰分开。

This workflow focuses on a Larry Turbo LoRA acceleration route for MiniMax H3. It is aimed at users who want a compact, fast image-to-video setup with a turbo sampler strategy and a simple structure that is easy to test.

The active chain uses a MiniMax H3 pruned INT8 ConvRot model, a Qwen3-VL MiniMax INT8 ConvRot text encoder, MiniMax H3 video and audio VAEs, and an enabled Larry Turbo LoRA. The graph is centered on a 16:9 output route and a short-step sampling setup.

This package is meant for practical ComfyUI and RunningHub users who want a ready-made MiniMax H3 graph instead of rebuilding loader, encoder, VAE, sampler, and video export connections by hand. The workflow is especially useful for speed comparison, hardware planning, and repeatable prompt tests. Keep the same source image and prompt when comparing versions so the difference you see comes from the workflow route, not from changing creative variables.

Main features:

- Larry Turbo LoRA is enabled on the reachable generation path
- MiniMax H3 pruned INT8 ConvRot model route for lighter execution
- Qwen3-VL MiniMax INT8 ConvRot text encoding
- Euler sampling with a beta 6-step schedule
- 16:9 widescreen resolution selector for video creation
- Clean single-output SaveVideo route
- Good fit for fast image-to-video speaking or character motion tests

Suggested workflow:

Use one clear starting image and keep the subject framed cleanly. Because this is a turbo route, test conservative prompts first: stable face, controlled hand motion, light camera movement, and a short spoken line if audio is used. If motion becomes too loose, reduce prompt complexity before changing the model path.

For better comparisons, make one small test first, review identity stability and temporal motion, then raise prompt complexity only after the base route behaves correctly. When using speaking-character prompts, keep the face visible, avoid too many fast cuts, and separate action, expression, and camera instructions clearly.
